About Me

My name is Thomas N. Que Jr. I am a Liberian Mathematics Instructor and educator. I am a graduate of the Kakata Rural Teacher Training Institute (KRTTI), Margibi County, where I specialized in Mathematics.

I am also a graduate of a theological seminary in Southeastern Liberia. I am committed to teaching, learning, Christian service, and helping young people develop knowledge, discipline, and confidence.
